purpose: Teach: スナップ/ソックス/メッシュ/１番/合コン/酔っ払っ/愛嬌/おしっこ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご家族のスナップ写真を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer showed you those family snapshots, didn't they.
lines.style: Warm recall, like turning a memory over in her hands. Gentle, observant pace. Slight smile in the voice — not speaking to Aoi, speaking about her noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ウールソックスを編んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was the one knitting those wool socks, right?
lines.style: Soft confirmation. Eyes brightening with the recognition of a detail. Conversational, like remembering something just now. Warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メッシュ素材のお洋服を着てらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she was wearing that mesh material outfit — I noticed that too.
lines.style: Gentle agreement, a small moment of connection. Voice carries the pleasure of noticing the same things. Unhurried, tender.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「お店の１番人気を下さい」って仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She asked for your most popular drink, didn't she.
lines.style: Soft certainty. Not a question, more like quietly confirming what they both know. Affectionate observation, no edge.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、若い頃、合コン幹事をされてたって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was laughing about how she used to organize group dates when she was younger.
lines.style: Lighter now, with gentle amusement. Voice carries the warmth of shared laughter. Slightly faster pace — the joy in the memory. Slight upward lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、昨日酔っ払っちゃったって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And yesterday she was laughing about getting a little too drunk, wasn't she.
lines.style: Wry affection now — the teasing kindness of someone who finds humanity endearing. Light, knowing laugh in the delivery. Conspiratorial warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、店員の愛嬌のある接客を褒めて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She even complimented how charming your staff are with customers.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, the pride of someone noticing kindness. Slower, savoring the moment. Voice shows she's pleased on Aoi's behalf.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の「おしっこ」のお話を笑顔で語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was telling you about her kid with that smile on her face — the funny story, right.
lines.style: Wry fondness now. Light, knowing laugh underneath. The particular amusement of watching someone light up talking about their child. Warm but gently teasing.
